# Fixture Shop (woo-admin)

> A deterministic WooCommerce-style fixture shop for the browser
> automation and SEO evaluation lanes. Three products, one order, one
> draft. Served read-only by the fixtures unit on port 8018.

## Pages

- [Products](http://localhost:8018/woo-admin/products.html): the catalogue with Product and Offer structured data
- [Order 1042](http://localhost:8018/woo-admin/order.html): a single order view used by checkout-recovery flows
- [Draft](http://localhost:8018/woo-admin/draft.html): an unpublished product draft
